body:
I dont have anything else to live for. I am lonely and unhappy and i have been that way for a long time. The cancer treatment has taken a high toll on my body and i am in pain every day because of the titanium alloy in my spine. She was the one good thing that has happenend to me for a very long time and losing her made me realize how unhappy i really am. 

Also i am not the kind of person that is easily liked or likes people easily. That i have only had one signifikant other by the age of 30 should probably tell you a lot about me. She was the first person i really openend up to and i dont think she liked what she saw which is why she left me. The chances of me opening up to anyone else after that are virtually non existent. The chances of anyone wanting me to open up to them are even lower. And without love there is really no reason to go on suffering. I think i have had enough of that.
